steps: Launch byte-identical copied original with copied Support Files
Point tool click (400,300); Save As point.gsp
Point tool click (700,500); Ctrl+A; Construct > Segment; Save As segment.gsp
Ctrl+M on selected segment; Save As midpoint.gsp
Arrow tool drag endpoint (400,300) to (460,340); observe midpoint moved; Save As midpoint-moved.gsp
Close document; Ctrl+O and open all five saved files together; inspect each, closing active document between inspections
